title: Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for September, 17th (AAPL, AGN, AMC, AMGN, ARGX, BRC, CRSP, DHER, HES, NI)
text:
Analysts Set Telefonica SA (TEF) PT at $8.98 Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for September, 17th (AAPL, AGN, AMC, AMGN, ARGX, BRC, CRSP, DHER, HES, NI) Tweet
Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Monday, September 17th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $200.00 target price by analysts at Rosenblatt Securities. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Allergan (NYSE:AGN) was given a $164.00 price target by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. The firm currently has a hold rating on the stock. AMC Entertainment (NYSE:AMC) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at William Blair.
Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) was given a $209.00 price target by analysts at Leerink Swann. The firm currently has a hold rating on the stock.
argenx (NASDAQ:ARGX) had its overweight rating reissued by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. The firm currently has a $154.00 target price on the stock.
Brady (NYSE:BRC) was given a $42.00 price target by analysts at Bank of America Corp. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
Crispr Therapeutics (NASDAQ:CRSP) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at Cann. The analysts wrote, “The diabetes field is a large and important market for therapeutic development and this collaboration between CRISPR Therapeutics and ViaCyte has the promise of leading to additional clinical pipeline programs for CRISPR Therapeutics in a new disease setting. However, based on it currently being in the discovery phase, we believe it is too early to adjust our outlook. Therefore, our outlook and estimates for revenue remain unchanged at this time.””
Delivery Hero (ETR:DHER) was given a €57.00 ($66.28) target price by analysts at Morgan Stanley. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Hess (NYSE:HES) was given a $86.00 target price by analysts at Bank of America Corp. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton (EPA:MC) was given a €325.00 ($377.91) price target by analysts at Morgan Stanley. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
NiSource (NYSE:NI) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Bank of America Corp. Bank of America Corp currently has a $28.00 price target on the stock.
Prosiebensat 1 Media (ETR:PSM) was given a €45.00 ($52.33) target price by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
RTL Group S.A. (EPA) (EBR:RTL) was given a €80.00 ($93.02) price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
